rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. Both enter zero for an employee who is not FLSA-eligible and figure the FLSA Overtime Premium by the same methods (the amount as reported, one-third, one-half or one-fourth). The second's 'other' branch is never reached, as its note says, because the refusal (otjob.refused) stops the line first. Its reading that only overtime included in box 1 is entered is resolved by the line 14a instruction, now in the otjob.statement question: overtime not in box 1 is included.
